plan.notes: Source: UAB 2026-2027 Catalog of Undergraduate Programs, official 'Proposed Program of Study' table at https://catalog.uab.edu/undergraduate/collegeofartsciences/psychology/. Department of Psychology, standard 4-year track (the catalog also publishes an accelerated 3-year track with summer terms; this plan follows the standard 4-year sequence). Term subtotals verified against the published table (15/15/13/15/16/16/15/15 = 120). PY 101, PY 212 and PY 218 may be replaced by their Honors equivalents (PY 201, PY 222, PY 228) per the catalog. A minor is recommended but not required; minor slots are student-choice courses. The Psychology Elective (Select One) slots are the practicum choice: PY 396 Teaching Practicum, PY 397 Community-Based Practicum, or PY 398 Research Practicum. PY 216L is a required 0-credit co-requisite lab (required_zero).
